versions.content: Service Name Ipdu M_ Main Function Tx Syntax void Ipdu M_ Main Function Tx ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x12 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different instances. Non reentrant for the same instance. Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This function performs the processing of the transmission activities that are not directly handled within the calls from Pdu R. Per configured Ipdu MMain Function Tx instance one Ipdu M_ Main Function Tx_<short Name> shall be implemented. Hereby <short Name> is the short name of the Ipdu MMain Function Tx configuration container in the ECU configuration. Available via Ipdu M_ Sch M.h
